subtitle: Master the language of music and unlock the fretboard with comprehensive theory lessons designed specifically for guitar players.
heroDescription: Move beyond memorizing chord shapes and scale patterns. Understand the "why" behind the music you play. These theory lessons are designed specifically for guitarists, connecting abstract concepts to practical fretboard application.

items.title: Understand Your Fretboard
items.description: Once you see the fretboard as a grid of intervals rather than a set of memorized shapes, every new chord or scale becomes a variation on patterns you already know.

items.title: Communicate with Musicians
items.description: Knowing the names of the chords and scales you're playing lets you follow a bandmate's instructions or call out a key change, instead of only playing what you've memorized by rote.

items.title: Write Better Songs
items.description: Understanding why certain chords lead naturally to others lets you write progressions on purpose, rather than hunting for chords that happen to sound right by trial and error.

items.title: Improvise Confidently
items.description: Knowing which notes belong to the underlying scale or chord, and why, is what lets you solo with intention instead of hoping your fingers land somewhere that works.

items.title: Intervals
items.description: Master the building blocks of harmony and melody

items.title: Scales
items.description: Understand the patterns that form melodies and harmony

items.title: Chords
items.description: Build and understand chord structures and voicings

items.title: Modes
items.description: Explore the colors and moods of modal harmony

items.title: Chord Progressions
items.description: Learn how chords connect to create harmonic motion

columns.title: Guitar-Focused Learning
columns.text: Every concept is explained with guitar-specific examples and fretboard diagrams. We connect theory to the physical layout of the guitar, making abstract concepts concrete and practical.

columns.title: Progressive Complexity
columns.text: Start with fundamental concepts and build complexity gradually. Each lesson builds on previous knowledge, ensuring you develop a solid foundation before moving to advanced topics.

gettingStarted.title: Ready to Begin?
gettingStarted.description: Start your music theory journey today. Whether you're a complete beginner or looking to fill gaps in your knowledge, these lessons will enhance your musical understanding and guitar playing.
